name: TASK_OBJECTIVE_LIFECYCLE_REVIEW_V1
task_execution_projection: fold append-only task_execution_events in deterministic recorded_at_utc,event_id order; corrections target exact prior evidence

no-history authority has neither projection nor events and reads as not_started/execution_revision=0 without persistence; any event requires a positive-revision projection, including corrected-to-not_started history; history without projection fails closed
not_started: no current-effective start and no current-effective termination/cancel event
in_progress: one current-effective start exists and no current-effective end/termination closes it
ended: current-effective start/end exist, end>=start, with no later effective termination superseding that interpretation
terminated: current-effective manual_cancel/rfc_terminal_terminate/source_terminal_consequence closes executable work; preserve actual_start when accepted and never fabricate actual_end
correction may replace/withdraw an exact occurrence time only when the resulting full chronology remains valid; prior evidence stays immutable
recorded_at never substitutes for unknown/missing effective occurrence time
task_revision_freshness: tasks.revision is umbrella freshness for material Task-owned mutable authority: accepted plan, relationship, explicit lock, activity classification, execution, reviewed outcome and governed local terminal consequence each advance it once unless the owning command explicitly defines separate immutable topology, e.g. LinkWfmRetryAttempt
owned sub-projection revisions remain independent and must still be revalidated exactly
cross-domain Task-revision captures, including RFC-terminal participation, therefore cannot cross unseen material local execution/outcome changes
task_review_state: if current task_outcome_current remains valid against corrected execution evidence => reviewed with accepted outcome/reviewed_at
else if execution_state in ended|terminated => awaiting_review
else if current Objective envelope is due/past with no accepted outcome => read-time awaiting_review/due_unreviewed without creating execution/outcome or mutating aggregate authority

completed: requires execution_state=ended with accepted actual_start and actual_end
provider Complete, Objective end, review time or termination alone never qualifies
incomplete: requires accepted actual_start and execution_state in ended|terminated
reason_category required when current evidence does not explain incompleteness
cancelled_without_execution: requires no current-effective accepted start and execution_state=terminated
manual_cancel, RFC terminal consequence or reviewed source-terminal consequence may supply termination; provider status alone may not

correction_rule: ReviewTaskOutcome cannot overwrite a current accepted outcome; use CorrectTaskOutcome
CorrectTaskOutcome appends correction_of exact current event and must satisfy current corrected execution
Task identity, execution evidence, prior outcome event and reviewed_at are preserved
material aggregate change invalidates prior Objective review fingerprint without editing/deleting objective_review_events

plan_lock_true_if: terminal/historical Objective membership whose plan rewrite would alter protected structure
membership_lock_true_if: protected retry/history consequence that a move would rewrite
effective_locks.rule: clock passage across a plan boundary never creates either lock; corrections use governed paths

task_executable.true_when: no current-effective termination/cancelled outcome, not historical-only provider/local terminal work, and RFC/WFM eligibility permits execution
false_when: provider Plan Cancel/Complete local consequence accepted as termination
task_executable.rule: provider status alone does not make local executable=false until governed consequence/cascade applies, except historical Tasks adopted from already-terminal provider evidence that never became executable

objective_aggregate_derivation: exact material input, canonical fingerprint, absence tokens, review-currentness and projection-revision semantics are OBJECTIVE_AGGREGATE_INPUT_V1 in algorithms/objective-aggregate.json
load current nonsuperseded membership, pinned plan revisions, Task execution/outcome, operational-count inclusion and current valid review fingerprint
envelope=min pinned start/max pinned end; member_count>0
actual_start_utc=min accepted member actual_start, else null

actual_end_utc stays null while any started member is in_progress; once all started members are terminal, use max(actual_end_utc or effective_termination_utc) across known terminal occurrences; any unknown terminal occurrence leaves it unknown
superseded => execution_state=superseded with no new editable aggregate outcome
historical_provider_complete with no accepted Task execution => historical_structure; aggregate_outcome null unless all current members excluded, then excluded_from_operational_counts
if accepted work began and governed transition leaves zero executable members before all outcomes reviewed => awaiting_review/lost_last_executable

if all current members have valid accepted outcomes => derive aggregate outcome; reviewed only when a current objective_review_event fingerprint matches exact membership/outcome/inclusion, else awaiting_review

otherwise persisted aggregate remains planned; ObjectiveList/Workbench/ReviewQueue derive due_unreviewed from explicit as_of_utc and pinned envelope without writing a receipt, audit event or projection revision
current plan differing from any membership pin adds plan_membership_mismatch unless higher safety attention applies

objective_outcome_derivation.included_population: current members whose effective operational-count inclusion is true; exclusion never deletes membership/history
objective_outcome_derivation.excluded_all: empty included population plus at least one excluded member => excluded_from_operational_counts
objective_outcome_derivation.cancelled: all included outcomes cancelled_without_execution AND no current/corrected historical member actual_start
objective_outcome_derivation.incomplete: all included outcomes incomplete; UI/report may normalize a completed+incomplete mixture as failure, but canonical aggregate stays mixed
objective_outcome_derivation.mixed: two or more distinct included Task outcomes
objective_outcome_derivation.rule: canonical aggregate is mixed for heterogeneous outcomes; whole-Objective Cancelled is impossible after any Task began execution

objective_review_fingerprint.fields: version; objective_id/revision; sorted current task_id + membership revision + pinned plan revision + execution revision (0=exact no-history) + current outcome event/revision + inclusion revision/default; supersession state
objective_review_fingerprint.rule: reviewed_at is server recording time after exact fingerprint revalidation and never execution chronology

source_terminal_review: accepted LLD-04 WFM Complete/Plan Cancel remains provider evidence/current source projection only

if local executable work or Objective consequence remains, create/supersede pending wfm_source_terminal_reviews bound to exact source projection revision and local input fingerprint; append no execution/outcome evidence

local fingerprint includes Task revision, execution revision/state (0=exact no-history), outcome revision, current plan revision, membership objective/pin/revision, effective locks and provider source projection revision
retain_local_work records only the decision; later material source/local state may create a fresh review
terminate_local_work appends one source_terminal_consequence execution event in the same UoW and transitions that review; no Task outcome
after termination rebuild affected Objective aggregate; loss of the last executable Task from in_progress yields lost_last_executable/awaiting_review, otherwise surviving work remains with warning
Plan Cancel/Complete never changes SR/RFC lifecycle, Inventory or Communications here
rfc_terminal_participant: capture_applicable_wfms under caller LLD-03 UoW returns ordered task_id/task revision/task_no for exact active locally executable WFM Tasks owned by the cascade RFC set
preview reports affected Objectives, surviving executable counts and in-progress last-executable loss; incomplete authority => INDETERMINATE
writer revalidation recomputes complete Task/Objective impact and exact-compares reviewed exact_count/provider_fingerprint before proof consumption
apply runs only after cross-domain READY checks, deliberate proof consumption and outer receipt; it receives RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 and no proof/session secret

apply revalidates captured identity/revision/ownership, appends rfc_terminal_terminate events, advances each affected Task and execution projection revision once, rebuilds affected Objective projections, leaves provider source projection untouched and accepts no outcome
all provider-owned consequence/history/audit rows reference command_context.command_id; no nested receipt/commit/rollback

compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_RESULT_V1 from domain TASKS_OBJECTIVES, outer command_id, proposal_id, complete ordered immutable result refs and provider audit IDs; return only RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 exact counts/fingerprint
apply summary is bounded correlation evidence only; consequence cardinality has no product maximum and complete results never cross into LLD-03 audit
unrelated Local Tasks and WFM Tasks outside exact RFC scope stay untouched
all projection rebuilds use caller UoW; any failure rolls back the whole RFC cascade
objective_cancel: whole Objective cancel first proves no member has current-effective or historical-uncorrected accepted start
record explicit cancellation evidence/outcome per Task rather than Objective-owned cancellation truth
aggregate Cancelled derives only from member outcomes plus valid Objective review fingerprint
